title: Command Palette Dock blank on secondary display/monitor.

judgment.rationale: The latest maintainer clarification and current Dock tests show that blank secondary-monitor docks are intentional until the user customizes that monitor-specific dock.
evidence: Reporter enabled Dock Preview and enabled the Dock for a secondary monitor; the visible secondary dock bar was blank.
Another commenter confirmed a blank secondary dock but said right-clicking and choosing Edit Dock allowed adding bands.
On 2026-09-08 michaeljolley clarified that secondary monitors do not receive preconfigured bands; they are a blank canvas customized through Edit Dock.
Related #48516 was fixed by merged PR #49814 for monitor-topology changes; #48466 remains a separate positioning/scaling issue, not the blank-band default described here.
judgment.recommended_action: Treat the current report as by-design documentation/support guidance unless new evidence shows customized secondary-dock bands fail to render.

fix_assessment.rationale: The current behavior is intentional: secondary-monitor docks start empty and are customized independently, so no PowerToys code fix is indicated by the latest evidence.

issue_context.summary: The report describes a secondary-monitor Command Palette Dock that reserves space but shows no PC-vitals/default bands. Current maintainer guidance states this is expected: primary monitors get default bands, while secondary monitors start blank and must be customized through Edit Dock.
known_information: Issue is open and labeled Issue-Bug, Needs-Triage, Product-Command Palette, and CmdPal - Dock.
The issue is in the CmdPal Roadmap project with status Todo.
Reporter used PowerToys 0.100.2 from the Microsoft Store on Windows 10.0.26200 and attached a PowerToys report ZIP plus a screenshot/recording link.
Reporter explicitly enabled the Dock for the secondary monitor and observed an empty bar at the top.
Iautner reproduced the blank secondary dock and found they could right-click, choose Edit Dock, and add bands.
michaeljolley stated that primary monitors get default things like perf monitor bands, but secondary monitors are a blank canvas.
inferences: The empty secondary bar itself is not evidence of a rendering bug under the current design.
The issue may indicate discoverability/documentation friction for the secondary-dock customization flow rather than an implementation defect.
If future evidence shows user-pinned bands disappearing or failing to render on the secondary monitor, that would be a distinct bug from the default blank state.
issue_context.analysis: Full issue review plus focused source/test inspection aligns the reported blank secondary dock with the intended per-monitor design. Since linked monitor-topology work (#48516/#49814) and positioning work (#48466) cover different symptoms, this item should not start a duplicate fix design from the current evidence.
initial_investigation: Read live issue body, labels, assignees, comments, timeline, events, and project item context for #49604.
Read linked issues #49598, #48516, and #48466 to distinguish blank bands from monitor-topology and positioning/scaling problems.
Read PR #49814, which fixed Dock breakage during monitor topology changes and explicitly left scaling behavior to #48466.
Inspected DockSettings.cs: global bands include built-in home, WinGet, PerformanceMonitor, network speed, and datetime defaults; per-monitor configs can hold independent bands.
Inspected DockMultiMonitorTests.cs: the test Reconciler_NewSecondaryMonitor_StartsWithEmptyBands documents the expected empty secondary-monitor band lists.
Inspected DockMonitorConfigViewModel.cs: enabling customization forks global bands for a monitor, while per-monitor band lists are otherwise independently managed.

information_gaps.information: Evidence that bands explicitly pinned through Edit Dock on the secondary monitor disappear or fail to render.
information_gaps.why_needed: Would distinguish a real per-monitor band-rendering bug from the intended blank default state.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: If the problem persists after pinning bands to the secondary dock, comment with the pinned-band list and a fresh /bugreport captured immediately after reproducing.

comment.body: The latest maintainer clarification and current Dock behavior indicate this is expected for a newly enabled secondary-monitor dock: primary monitors get default bands such as PC vitals, while secondary monitor docks start as a blank canvas. Right-click the secondary dock, choose `Edit Dock`, and pin the bands you want on that monitor. If bands that were explicitly pinned to the secondary dock still do not render, please comment with the pinned-band list and a fresh `/bugreport` captured immediately after reproducing so that can be tracked as a separate rendering/persistence bug.
